hook.description: Lady Harrington tauntingly asks, 'Imagine Juliana seeing this.'
hook.evidence: The immediate mention of a victim and a cruel plot establishes high stakes and immediate conflict.

candidates.reason: The dialogue establishes a clear villainous plot against a specific target, creating immediate intrigue.

hook.description: A Royal Guard bows to an elder nobleman while discussing the sealing of all exits.
hook.evidence: The visual of a guard confirming a lockdown creates an immediate sense of danger and conspiracy.

candidates.reason: The cold declaration that the 'witch' will be dead by sunset provides a high-stakes ticking clock.

hook.description: Catherine silhouetted in the bright doorway in a magnificent bridal gown.
hook.evidence: The visual contrast of the bride entering the cathedral is a classic, high-production-value hook.

candidates.reason: The contrast between the beautiful wedding and the conspiratorial dialogue between the couple highlights the show's theme of betrayal.
